name: Tomáš Zdechovský - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Public Prosecutor's Office spent its 2023 budget of about 66 million euros, after the EU Court of Auditors gave the accounts a clean bill of health. It also sets out recommendations: give the office more money and staff for its growing caseload, fix its IT and security gaps, improve staff conditions, and push Hungary to join. The report is largely an opinion with recommendations; the binding effect is the approval of the 2023 accounts.

- **What changes:** Parliament formally approves the office's 2023 spending and closes its accounts.
- **Who it affects:** The EU Public Prosecutor's Office, its staff, and EU taxpayers whose money it protects.
- **What happens next:** The office must act on Parliament's recommendations, especially on funding, IT and staffing.
